idea-plugin.name: JDBC Double-Close Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a JDBC resource (Connection/ Statement/PreparedStatement/ CallableStatement/ResultSet) .close() reached with the resource already closed -- on EVERY path reaching it (a certain double-close) or on SOME path (a real, path-dependent risk) -- plus a use of the resource reached with it already closed on every path.

Built on a real path-sensitive typestate analysis: every tracked resource variable's possible states are propagated through the method's own statement structure, MERGING (set union) the two branches of every if/else, try/catch, and loop body -- the same "meet over all paths" idea a real dataflow framework uses, implemented via AST-structural recursion rather than an explicit CFG graph (Java's structured control flow doesn't need one for this to be genuinely path-sensitive).

Stated honestly: the platform's own bundled "JDBC resource opened but not safely closed" inspection covers LEAKS (never closing) -- a different bug class entirely, never double-close or use-after-close with real branch sensitivity. No dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: JDBC resource closed twice or used after close
